campaign.title: Compare the actual Mellin sector with its functional-equation reflection

conductor_policy.monitoring: Require finite contour truncation. Track z=u+v, gamma heights, every pole, scale/floor factor, and the top 1/u principal value.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close only after exact algebra, hostile scope review, and a signed estimate or proved obstruction.

numerical_purpose: bounded falsification of signs, residues, or reflection constants
resource_policy.literature_policy: Primary sources only for a theorem used beyond accepted functional equations.

exit_gates: top Perron sign and maximal scope
campaign.promotion_policy: A reflected-mode formula promotes only with exact contours and residues; a bound requires uniform complex-height and hard-top control.

closing_assessment.main_result: Finite-height reflection is exact only with zeta, height, hard-top Perron, and endpoint residues retained. Ideal reflected Perron sectors complete the Hardy angular coefficient rather than cancel; actual M1 profiles lack the reflected scale and leave an explicit maximal angular-sign kernel.
